# Tegan Lochner {#welcome}

<!-- CHANGE THIS: replace with your own name above -->

Welcome to my portfolio for **MUSA 5080: Public Policy Analytics** at the
University of Pennsylvania.

This site documents my work in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics program —
weekly notes, course assignments, and a final project applying data analysis to
urban policy questions.

## About Me

<!-- CHANGE THIS: two or three sentences about yourself -->

I am a current student in the MUSA program at Penn. My background is in landscape architecture, I graduated with a BLA from Penn State in 2024 and subsequently began work in Chicago as a landscape designer and analyst. At Penn, I work as a research assistant in the Department of Earth and Environmental Science as a part of the Penn Climate Cohort. Additionally, I also work in book preservation in the Kislak Center for Special Collections, Rare Books and Manuscripts.
